name: The Beautiful Oil
description: Skin nourishment, bottled. A lightweight, active facial oil to treat signs of dehydration and impart a healthy, radiant glow.

gallery.alt: Model holding The Beautiful Oil against her cheek, winking

details.title: Benefits
details.body: Hydrates and locks in moisture, improves skin tone and absorbs rapidly — a moisturiser for your skin and a primer for your makeup.

details.title: Ingredients
details.body: Cold-pressed, certified-organic Sweet Almond Oil, Root of Light and Rosehip Seed Oil, with Jojoba and Sea Buckthorn for a healthy glow.

details.title: Packaging
details.body: The Iconic Edition glass bottle is made to keep. When you run out, order the refill and pour it in — less waste, same ritual.

details.title: How to use
details.body: Warm 3–4 drops between your palms and press onto clean skin, morning and night. Wait a few minutes before applying makeup.

details.title: FAQs
details.body: Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. Store away from direct sunlight and use within 12 months of opening.

statement.title: Golden,
statement.imageAlt: Before and after: skin looks dewy and radiant after The Beautiful Oil
statement.text: Rapidly absorbed — instant, dewy radiance without leaving a film on the skin.

benefits.title: Improves skin tone
benefits.text: Helps reduce the appearance of pigmentation, dullness, redness and blemishes.

benefits.title: Hydrates & locks moisture
benefits.text: Balances the complexion and melts away dehydration, locking moisture deep into the skin.

benefits.title: Moisturiser & primer
benefits.text: Works as a moisturiser for your skin and a primer for your makeup — glow instantly and over time.

ingredients.title: Ingredients with integrity.
ingredients.imageAlt: Kjaer Weis bottles laid out on blue linen

items.name: Rosehip Seed Oil
items.text: Soothes and reduces the appearance of dark marks.

ingredients.fullList: Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil*, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil*, Rosa Canina (Rosehip) Seed Oil*, Hippophae Rhamnoides (Sea Buckthorn) Fruit Oil*, Coleus Forskohlii (Root of Light) Root Extract*, Tocopherol. *Certified organic.

routine.title: Cleanse, tone,

steps.text: Start fresh: lift away the day.
Fortify with nutrients, radiance and long-lasting hydration.

routine.tip: Tip — wait 3–4 minutes for the oil to absorb before applying makeup. Also lovely on the ends of hair, nails and cuticles.
